## 📄 論文總結

本日論文聚焦於模型與硬體協同設計，以提升AI與圖形運算效率；共同技術主軸為低精度運算、細粒度資源調度與增量式演算法，突破點在於同時達到三值內視分割、光線追蹤單元、預取調度、超維資料聚類與混合精度 GEMM 的速能雙提升。這些工作共同示證了跨層協同優化在多樣化計算任務中的普遍適用性。


**精選論文清單：**
- [TernScope: Model-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient Ternary Endoscopic Segmentation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29617v1) — 作者群：Zhuoyu Wu, Wenhui Ou, Qiawei Zheng, Xuhong Qiu, Wenqi Fang et al. (`arXiv`) 💻[程式碼](https://github.com/ReaganWu/TernScope)
- [Ray-by-Ray: Fine-Grained Resource Management for GPU Ray Tracing Units](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31630v1) — 作者群：Junrui Pan, Cesar Avalos Baddouh, Kai Ze Ee, Timothy G. Rogers (`arXiv`)
- [SnakeCharmer: Orchestrating Utility, Timeliness, and Placement in GPU Prefetching](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30990v1) — 作者群：Yuhan Tang, Tiejun Li, Jianmin Zhang, An Hu, Guangyu Sun et al. (`arXiv`)
- [HDLouvain: High-Throughput Incremental Clustering for Hyperdimensional Data](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30687v1) — 作者群：Beenish Gul, Mahbod Afarin, Farhat Ahmed, Sumukh Pinge, Tsung-Han Lu et al. (`arXiv`)
- [FIGFLEX: A Mixed-Precision FP-INT GEMM Accelerator Co-Designed with Low-Bit LLM Quantization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30480v1) — 作者群：Faraz Tahmasebi, Haocheng Xu, Andrew Trauger, Yomal Perera, Zhenyu Tang et al. (`arXiv`)
